description_en: Modifies the name and description of a vRouter
description_zh: 调用ModifyVRouterAttribute接口修改路由器的名称和描述信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-vrouter-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vrouter-id vrt-gw0p7zigake75znix0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVRouterAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the vRouter to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的路由器所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the vRouter.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
路由器的名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: vrouter_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the vRouter.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
路由器的描述信息。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description
